Agrippa, then, was doing these things, and he also drove the astrologers and the sorcerers out of the city; and about the same days a decree was passed that no one belonging to the senate should be tried for brigandage, and so those who were then under some such charge were released, and for the future impunity for some to commit crimes

anyone, nor any sorcerer, to exist. For divination is necessary, and by all means appoint some men as inspectors of sacrifices and as augurs, to whom those who wish to consult about anything may resort; but magicians ought not to exist at all.
